notes: Read all 64 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; the relative() helper, the TONE table, the props, the pulse-on-reconnecting visual, and the role=status/aria-live accessibility intent are preserved.

L1-13 JSDoc header (LiveStatusPill connection-state badge; live/reconnecting/offline semantics; 'Updated <relative>' rationale): ported as the native port header comment, keeping the three-state semantics and the operator-verification rationale.

L15 `import { useMemo } from 'react'`: used directly (RN supports useMemo); kept the same [now, lastUpdateAt] memo dependency for the relative label. useEffect/useRef are additionally imported for the native pulse animation.

L16 `import { Wifi, WifiOff, Activity } from 'lucide-react'`: no native renderer. Each small inline icon -> a monochrome AppText glyph tinted to the pill text colour (the LiveIndicator / DataPipelineSection precedent of replacing small inline lucide icons with glyphs rather than the heavier bordered SemanticIcon chip): Activity->'\u25C9' (fisheye pulse-mark) for live, Wifi->'\u25CC' (dotted circle, searching) for reconnecting, WifiOff->'\u2298' (circled slash, off) for offline.
L17 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'`: dropped — native composes StyleSheet objects + inline colour overrides via style arrays instead of className concatenation.

L18 `import type { StatusLiveState } from '../../hooks/useStatusLiveSSE'`: the native useStatusLiveSSE hook is not yet ported, so the union is declared + exported locally as `export type StatusLiveState = 'live' | 'reconnecting' | 'offline'`, byte-identical to the web type (web hook L56), so native callers share the same contract.
L20-25 `interface LiveStatusPillProps { state; lastUpdateAt: number | null; now: number }`: ported verbatim, including the JSDoc on `now` ('"now" tick passed in so the relative label re-renders').

L27-34 `function relative(now, lastUpdateAt)`: ported verbatim — the lastUpdateAt==null -> '\u2014' guard, Math.max(0, floor((now-lastUpdateAt)/1000)), and the <5 'just now' / <60 `${secs}s ago` / <3600 `${m}m ago` / else `${h}h ago` ladder with the same hard-coded English strings (the source uses no i18n, so no shim is introduced).

L36-40 `const TONE: Record<StatusLiveState, {...}>`: ported as a typed ToneSpec record. Every Tailwind token is mapped to a literal colour matching the web palette exactly: live dot bg-green-400->#4ade80, text-green-300->#86efac, bg-green-500/10->rgba(34,197,94,0.1), ring-green-400/30->rgba(74,222,128,0.3), pulse:false, Icon Activity->glyph '\u25C9', label 'Live'; reconnecting dot bg-amber-400->#fbbf24, text-amber-200->#fde68a, bg-amber-500/10->rgba(245,158,11,0.1), ring-amber-400/30->rgba(251,191,36,0.3), pulse:true, Icon Wifi->glyph '\u25CC', label 'Reconnecting'; offline dot bg-zinc-400->#a1a1aa, text-zinc-300->#d4d4d8, bg-zinc-500/10->rgba(113,113,122,0.1), ring-zinc-400/30->rgba(161,161,170,0.3), pulse:false, Icon WifiOff->glyph '\u2298', label 'Offline'. The lucide `Icon: typeof Wifi` field becomes a `glyph: string` field carrying the per-state mark.

L42-45 `export function LiveStatusPill({ state, lastUpdateAt, now })` + `const tone = TONE[state]` + `const { Icon } = tone` + `const rel = useMemo(() => relative(now, lastUpdateAt), [now, lastUpdateAt])`: ported. The Icon destructure is folded into tone.glyph; rel keeps the identical useMemo dependency array.

L46-56 outer `<span>` pill: -> a <View> with styles.pill (web `inline-flex items-center` -> flexDirection row + alignItems center + alignSelf flex-start so it shrink-wraps like inline-flex; `gap-1.5` -> gap 6; `rounded-full` -> borderRadius 999; `px-2.5 py-1` -> paddingHorizontal 10 / paddingVertical 4; `ring-1` + ring colour -> borderWidth 1 + borderColor tone.ring; `text-xs font-medium` -> AppText variant=caption (12px) + fontWeight 500 on the text rows; `tabular-nums` -> fontVariant ['tabular-nums'] on the rel cell). tone.cls bg -> backgroundColor tone.bg. Accessibility: role="status" (L52) -> accessible + accessibilityRole="text" + accessibilityLiveRegion="polite" (the GrafanaPanelPage/EditConflictBanner precedent for role=status); aria-live="polite" (L53) -> accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"; aria-label (L54) `Live status stream: ${tone.label}, updated ${rel}` -> identical accessibilityLabel; data-status-live-state={state} (L55) -> testID=`status-live-state-${state}` (RN has no data-* attrs; the state marker is preserved as a queryable testID).

L57 dot `<span class='inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full' + tone.dot + tone.pulse && 'animate-pulse' aria-hidden>`: -> an Animated.View (styles.dot = 8x8 borderRadius 4, web h-2 w-2 rounded-full) with backgroundColor tone.dot and an animated opacity. animate-pulse (only reconnecting) -> an Animated.loop(sequence(timing 1->0.5, timing 0.5->1)) at Easing.inOut(Easing.ease), 1000ms each half (Tailwind pulse is opacity 1<->0.5 over ~2s), useNativeDriver true, started in a useEffect gated on tone.pulse and stopped via the returned cleanup so no animation handle leaks under --detectOpenHandles; non-pulsing states pin opacity to 1. aria-hidden -> the dot is a non-accessible decorative View (the View itself isn't flagged accessible; the pill carries the composed label).

L58 `<Icon className='h-3.5 w-3.5' aria-hidden />`: -> an AppText (styles.icon fontSize 11/lineHeight 14, the ~14px h-3.5) coloured to tone.text, rendering tone.glyph; decorative (no accessibility flag), consistent with web aria-hidden.
L59 `{tone.label}`: -> AppText variant=caption fontWeight 500 coloured tone.text rendering tone.label.
L60 `·`: -> AppText variant=caption styles.muted (colors.textMuted = --text-muted) rendering the '\u00B7' middot.
L61 `{rel}`: -> AppText variant=caption styles.muted + styles.rel (fontVariant tabular-nums) rendering rel.
L62-64 closing `` / return / function braces: ported; the component is also default-exported for native import ergonomics.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only React, react-native primitives (Animated/Easing/StyleSheet/View) and the existing apps/native AppText component + theme tokens.
